title: Introducing Fini MCP: Build, Test and Improve Your AI Support Agent from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini
summary: Fini MCP brings your AI support agent into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor. Build, test, improve and monitor it by asking. Every change needs approval.
body_markdown: Fini MCP is an MCP server for customer support. It puts the whole Fini platform inside the AI tools your team already works in, so you can set up an AI customer service agent, test it, improve it every week and watch it, all by asking.
